ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Mpclient.DLL Sideloading Via Defender Binaries
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential sideloading of "mpclient.dll" by Windows Defender processes ("MpCmdRun" and "NisSrv") from their non-default directory.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\MpCmdRun\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\NisSrv\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Security\\ Client\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
